prompt: Create an original 150 second Indian acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: sitar, bansuri, tabla, tanpura. Style: gradually unfolding modal melody and intricate tabla. Tempo approximately 86 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A lively and traditional Indian instrumental piece featuring prominent sitar melodies, tabla rhythms, and a drone-like accompaniment, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼的传统印度器乐曲，以突出的西塔琴旋律、塔布拉鼓节奏和嗡嗡作响的伴奏为特色，营造出充满活力和能量的氛围。
